quest.514011153A0580F2.quest_desc: The Smoking Augment switches the furnace to food-smoking recipes. Install it in a dedicated food furnace and test one portion of a suitable raw ingredient.
Ore or stone will not process merely because the same furnace previously smelted them. Keep another furnace unspecialised or sort inputs before feeding a mixed workshop.
quest.514011153A0580F2.title: Obtain 1 × Augment: Smoking
quest.51401117A75D3720.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Netherite Furnace (ironfurnaces:netherite_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Netherite Ingot.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Netherite Furnace. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.51401117A75D3720.title: Obtain 1 × Netherite Furnace
quest.51401118B1E42386.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Crystal Furnace (ironfurnaces:crystal_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51401118B1E42386.title: Obtain 1 × Crystal Furnace
quest.5140112AC3C39CA4.quest_desc: The Generator Augment converts furnace heat into network energy. Install it, supply fuel and connect an energy receiver.
The furnace can no longer smelt items in generator mode. Use a Factory Augment when the goal is electric smelting; Generator and Factory serve different energy directions.
quest.5140112AC3C39CA4.title: Obtain 1 × Augment: Generator
quest.5140113C977B9BE0.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Silver Furnace (ironfurnaces:silver_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5140113C977B9BE0.title: Obtain 1 × Silver Furnace
quest.514011420ECB3AB6.quest_desc: Wireless heat needs both a Wireless Heat Transmitter and a Wireless Heat Receiver. Insert the receiver into the transmitter to bind it and supply FE to the transmitter.

Move the bound receiver into the fuel slot of an Iron-tier furnace or higher. Check its target tooltip and a real smelting cycle. The quest checks both items in your inventory, so obtain credit before installing the pair.
quest.514011420ECB3AB6.title: Obtain 1 × Wireless Heat Transmitter + Obtain 1 × Wireless Heat Receiver
quest.5140114B0DC80A94.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rainbow Plating (ironfurnaces:rainbow_plating). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5140114B0DC80A94.title: Obtain 1 × Rainbow Plating
quest.51401172C148C31C.quest_desc: The Speed Augment shortens smelting time but consumes more fuel. Prepare its required Precision Mechanism and install the augment through the furnace’s upgrade interface.

Compare the same batch before and after installation and check fuel supply. If the furnace already waits for ingredients or a blocked output, speeding up the operation alone will not increase line production.
quest.51401172C148C31C.title: Obtain 1 × Augment: Speed
quest.5140117351ED54D2.quest_desc: The Factory Augment makes the furnace use energy instead of ordinary fuel. Its SOQM recipe requires a Precision Mechanism; prepare an FE line for the operating load before installation.
After switching modes, supply energy and test one recipe with an empty output. Coal in the fuel slot does not replace FE, and the augment is not a generator.
quest.5140117351ED54D2.title: Obtain 1 × Augment: Factory
quest.514011907290DE48.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rainbow Core (ironfurnaces:rainbow_core). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514011907290DE48.title: Obtain 1 × Rainbow Core
quest.514011A4BB290307.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Iron Furnace (ironfurnaces:iron_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514011A4BB290307.title: Obtain 1 × Iron Furnace
quest.514011AAAA9555C0.quest_desc: The Diamond Furnace requires Quantum Processor and Dimensional Matrix in addition to the previous furnace and Precision Mechanism. This ladder resumes after the shared dimension materials.
Emerald and Crystal continue within that stage; Netherite needs lunar materials and Stellar Alloy. Choose furnace capacity for your actual throughput rather than its casing color.
quest.514011AAAA9555C0.title: Diamond Furnace after the Matrix
quest.514011BAFD0BA1DB.quest_desc: The Blasting Augment specialises a furnace for blasting recipes. After installation, test an ingredient with a blasting recipe and provide a dedicated input stream for it.
This mode does not accept every ordinary smelting recipe. If a familiar item stops processing, check its recipe type and installed augment before changing the power or fuel supply.
quest.514011BAFD0BA1DB.title: Obtain 1 × Augment: Blasting
quest.514011BB117FEF8D.quest_desc: The Furnace Settings Linker transfers configuration between furnaces. Fully configure one working furnace and test its inputs, outputs and control before using it as a template.

Right-click a furnace with the tool to copy settings, then sneak-right-click another furnace to apply them. Recheck the faces afterward: a differently oriented furnace can point its output into empty space.
quest.514011BB117FEF8D.title: Obtain 1 × Furnace Settings Linker
quest.514011C0231A0A1C.quest_desc: The Fuel Efficiency Augment gets more work from fuel at the cost of slower smelting. It suits steady production where fuel use matters more than completion time.
Install it and compare fuel consumption on an identical batch. It is not a speed upgrade: if smelting time is already the bottleneck, the economical mode can lengthen the queue.
quest.514011C0231A0A1C.title: Obtain 1 × Augment: Fuel Efficiency
quest.514011C570BA4F19.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rainbow Furnace (ironfurnaces:million_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514011C570BA4F19.quest_subtitle: Combine Rainbow Core and Rainbow Plating
quest.514011C570BA4F19.title: Obtain 1 × Rainbow Furnace
quest.514011DDB6B69693.quest_desc: This pack’s Golden Furnace requires control electronics, Precision Mechanism and Industrial Chassis. It belongs to the second production stage even if gold is available earlier.
Upgrade a compatible earlier furnace using the recipe and test a small batch. Augments serve different purposes; first choose speed, fuel efficiency or the required processing mode.
quest.514011DDB6B69693.title: Golden Furnace after Precision
quest.514011F9E7C41342.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Emerald Furnace (ironfurnaces:emerald_furnace). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514011F9E7C41342.title: Obtain 1 × Emerald Furnace
